name: fix-campaign-trap-map
about: Issue #30, mods/campaign: the HoH1 traps (spikes, flame jets, glyphs) only on one map's floors, the Crypt by default (campaign.trap_map), and on the Forsaken Tower's. A Bandit Keep floor logs placed 0/0 'not a trap map' and has no HWP trap glyph, and still gets its teleporter pad. A Crypt floor (temple_1) and the Forsaken Tower's first floor place traps. With campaign.trap_map 4 (every map) the keep floor places them again. Mods core + campaign.

steps.until: \[HWP:campaign\] traps: placed 0/0 on a \d+x\d+ floor \([^)]*mission bandit_keep, not a trap map: campaign.trap_map is crypt\)
steps.name: bandit_keep floor 0: no traps (not the trap map)
bandit_keep: no HWP trap glyph on the floor
the keep floor still gets its teleporter pad

steps.until: \[HWP:campaign\] traps: placed [1-9]\d*/\d+ on a \d+x\d+ floor \([^)]*mission crypt\)
steps.name: crypt floor 0: traps placed
crypt: trap units on the floor

steps.until: \[HWP:campaign\] traps: placed [1-9]\d*/\d+ on a \d+x\d+ floor \([^)]*mission hwp_forsaken_tower\)
steps.name: hwp_forsaken_tower floor 0: traps placed
hwp_forsaken_tower: trap units on the floor

steps.pattern: traps on on every map and the Forsaken Tower
steps.name: hwp campaign traps names the setting

steps.until: \[HWP:campaign\] traps: placed [1-9]\d*/\d+ on a \d+x\d+ floor \([^)]*mission bandit_keep\)
steps.name: bandit_keep floor 0: traps placed
bandit_keep: trap units on the floor
